title: 需求拆解包
tagline: 想法变 PRD,PRD 变任务

editor_note.text: 产品经理的流水线:to-spec 把一句话想法聊成像样的规格文档,to-tickets 把它拆成能直接建的任务,triage 给一堆待办排优先级,handoff 负责交接。作者 Matt Pocock 是 TypeScript 圈的老师傅,提示词写得很稳。建议按顺序用;规格没聊透就急着拆任务,拆出来的多半要返工。
editor_note.author: 主理人
editor_note.text_en: A product manager's pipeline: to-spec turns a one-line idea into a proper spec, to-tickets breaks it into ready-to-file tasks, triage prioritizes the backlog, handoff handles the handover. The author, Matt Pocock, is a veteran of the TypeScript community and writes very solid prompts. Use them in order; splitting tasks before the spec is settled usually means redoing them.

tagline_en: Ideas to PRDs, PRDs to tasks
